mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: discovery display requires disco_output_sorted()

summary: The v66 case explicitly selects alphabetical discovery order and reaches the live \ known command. C o_init.c:dodiscovered() gathers every discovered type, omits class headings for the global alphabetical mode, and calls disco_output_sorted() to sort the accumulated rows before displaying the text window. JavaScript dodiscovered() throws UnsupportedDiscoveryDisplayError for every order except default 'o', so the production command stops at step 41 before rendering the C window. The existing comparator, sortloot key formatter, class discovery implementation, and production command dispatch provide the helpers needed to implement the whole sorted branch without changing unrelated discovery paths.

source.branch: The hero has discovered at least one object type and flags.discosort selects 's', 'c', or 'a'; dodiscovered() buffers one class at a time for sortloot/class alphabetization or all classes for global alphabetization, then disco_output_sorted() orders and emits each buffer.
callers: cmd.c:cmdlist known row -> dodiscovered() for the ordinary '\' command
o_init.c:dodiscovered() -> disco_output_sorted() after each class in 's'/'c' order and once for global 'a' order
dependencies: o_init.c:discovered_cmp() (existing JavaScript comparator used by class discovery)
o_init.c:sortloot_descr() (existing JavaScript formatter backed by invent.c:loot_classify())
cmd.c:runKnownCommand() (existing production dispatcher and text-window owner)

evidence: challenges/cases/v66/v66-alphabetical-discoveries-action2.session.json selects OPTIONS=sortdiscoveries:a; its step 41 input is '\\' after #wizidentify and the recorder has already prepared known object types.

challenges/evaluations/accepted-f0581a7656691256c99c2e6deeebfdc57ff7e06c-v66.json reports 41/62 screens, 2855/2855 RNG calls, and 41/62 cursors, with the first stop at step 41 in o_init.c:disco_output_sorted.

nethack-c/upstream/src/o_init.c:741-760 defines disco_output_sorted(): qsorts lines with discovered_cmp(), removes the six-byte sortloot key while restoring the encounter prefix when lootsort is enabled, writes each line, and frees each buffer entry.

nethack-c/upstream/src/o_init.c:764-862 defines dodiscovered(): validates the sort option, gathers unique items and artifacts, loops through inventory classes, flushes at class boundaries for 's'/'c', accumulates across classes for 'a', emits headings under the C conditions, and displays the text window when count is nonzero.
nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:1749-1750 binds '\\' to the known/dodiscovered command; js/cmd.js:3111-3124 and 5167-5168 route the ordinary key through runKnownCommand() and displayTtyTextWindow().

js/o_init.js:880-903 currently throws UnsupportedDiscoveryDisplayError for 's', 'c', and 'a'; scripts/o_init-discoveries.test.mjs:111-132 asserts that obsolete refusal, and scripts/startup-sortdiscoveries.test.mjs:48-67 asserts the deferred live-command stop.
